structure.unit: Uniform Child Custody Jurisdiction and Enforcement Act

text.section: A court of this Commonwealth shall treat a foreign country as if it were a state of the United States for purposes of applying this article and Article 2 (§ 20-146.12 et seq.) of this chapter.

Except as otherwise provided in subsection C, a child custody determination made in a foreign country under factual circumstances in substantial conformity with the jurisdictional standards of this act must be recognized and enforced under Article 3 (§ 20-146.22 et seq.) of this chapter.
A court of this Commonwealth need not apply this act if the child custody law of a foreign country violates fundamental principles of human rights.
